# Monthly report intake

Fill this in once a month, per client, before asking for the report. Ten minutes of typing
here is what makes the difference between a deck that reports the month and a deck that
reports the half of the month a machine could reach on its own.

**Copy this file, do not edit it in place.** One filled copy per client per month, named
`intake_<Client>_<MONTH><YEAR>.md`. Keeping the blank original intact means next month starts
clean rather than from last month's numbers, which is the mistake that produces a report where
the follower count never moves.

**Leave a field blank if you do not have it.** Blank is honest and the deck will say
"not reported this month". A guessed number reaches a client as fact and cannot be walked back.

---

    Client:
    Month:                          (e.g. August 2026)
    Prepared by:

## Campaign and activity — what the agency did this month

The coverage log records what landed. This section records what was *done*, which is what
justifies the retainer and is invisible in the coverage data.

### Press activity

## Coverage the tracker will not have

The daily tracker cannot reach the Condé Nast India titles — Vogue India, GQ India,
Architectural Digest India, Condé Nast Traveller India — or Travel + Leisure Asia. Print-only
coverage is invisible to it too. If you have seen something in those, add it here so it
reaches the report and the log.

    Publication | Date | What it was | Link or "print only"
    ---------------------------------------------------------

---

## Context for the narrative

Two or three lines each. This is what turns a data deck into a report — the model can count
placements but cannot know that a launch slipped or that a critic visit is still pending.

    What went well this month, in your words:

    What was harder than expected, and why:

    What you want the client to focus on next month:

    Anything the client should NOT be told, or should be told carefully:
